title: Macro Window Agent Output
description: Deterministic advisory macro-window agent output artifact for fixture-backed Z2 research-pipeline evidence.

generated_at.description: Timezone-qualified ISO datetime copied from the committed fixture.

as_of_timestamp.description: Timezone-qualified ISO datetime copied from the committed fixture.

source_fixture_path.description: Repo-relative committed fixture path used as the sole input source.

source_fixture_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the referenced fixture file.

macro_window_flag.description: Deterministic advisory macro-window flag derived from the fixture.

event_class.description: Fixture-provided macro or narrative event class.

event_name.description: Fixture-provided macro or narrative event name.

deterministic.description: Whether the output was produced without stochastic, LLM, network, or live external inputs.

advisory_only.description: Whether the output has no runtime, overlay, OMS, risk, or execution authority.

notes.description: Boundary notes; must not imply runtime influence, execution authority, candidate recommendation, OMS, risk, or overlay authority.
